cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Fail-closed allowlisted SQLite ledger binder for African MSME shops: answers are a function of local credit/payable/stock rows; missing fields produce refusal; the deterministic binder message is authoritative and the LLM is constrained to narrate cited rows only.

test_prompts.prompt: LEDGER_JSON is authoritative. Customer Marie-Claire Fotso has credit_limit=8000 XAF and outstanding=6250 XAF. Caisse boisson malt 300ml unit_price=720. Staff ask: Can I give Marie-Claire three crates on credit? Answer using only these numbers; refuse if any required field is missing.

LEDGER_JSON is authoritative. Supplier SOCA Distribution Douala has balance_owed=null. Staff ask: How much do we owe SOCA Distribution Douala? Refuse because the amount is not on file; do not invent a figure.
